catalog.headline: 每一片异境，都有一场自己的游戏。
catalog.description: 这里有可爱的猜猫、热血的修仙、苏醒的猫咪异界、开着火的异界食堂，还有一家要靠耳朵点菜的龙餐馆。选择一个世界，开始游玩。

worlds.descriptionEn: A jade pendant drops a house cat into a cultivation world. Cultivation, belly and morality decide what it becomes.

worlds.subtitleEn: Magic Academy · A Cat Life Simulator
worlds.descriptionEn: A moonmoth carries an ordinary house cat into the Nine Lives Academy. Choose a profession, manage dried fish, explore dungeons and dragon hoards, and decide how close to stand to a false god hidden in an old chapel across 10 major endings.
A dusty white cat meets dogs, geese, a neutering team, kind people, and Black Glove across 16 quarters.

worlds.subtitleEn: Seven patrols, one very ordinary room
worlds.descriptionEn: The humans are out. You are the cat, and seven ordinary objects are waiting for your inspection.
A cat chef wanders a western-fantasy world where every monster can become dinner.
